opportunities.name: Bite-backed shield channel
opportunities.objective: Trade some tank resistance for AP that supports Consume and a protected R channel.
opportunities.mechanic: Consume has 0.9 AP non-champion healing and reduced champion healing, enhanced below half health. R has 1.5 AP shielding and up to 3 AP damage; Visage boosts self shielding/healing while Riftmaker requires a real combat ramp. E root can buy channel time and Abyssal only helps nearby magic damage.
opportunities.requiredState: An accessible bite target and E root exist; record actual R channel length.
opportunities.failure: Hard interruption ends the damage window; a monster heal cannot be assumed in a champion duel.
opportunities.test: Record Consume target type, healing, R shield and damage for short versus full channels.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Stat(12)[statFormula=2] in Q/R is retained and should not be silently read as total health.

opportunities.name: Snowball root relay
opportunities.objective: Turn the collision and delayed E root into an ally-focused vulnerability window.
opportunities.mechanic: W collision knocks up, then E only roots snowball-slowed nearby enemies after three seconds. Current Mandate triggers on immobilization, while Bandlepipes can trigger on slows or immobilization. Shurelya supports the follow-through and R slow/channel threatens a second zone.
opportunities.requiredState: Team can follow the W collision and remain near Nunu for E resolution.
opportunities.failure: An escaped E target or poor W steering wastes the ally items.
opportunities.test: Time W impact, E root, Mandate mark and allied damage within the four-second mark window.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: An E snowball hit alone is not the delayed root.

ruledOut.reason: Q specifies true damage only for minions/monsters; champion Consume is magic damage.

unknowns: R/Q health formulas retain statFormula=2; R interruption and item timing need live logs. Passive splash does not establish inherited item on-hits.

testPlan: Required state: An accessible bite target and E root exist; record actual R channel length.
Record Consume target type, healing, R shield and damage for short versus full channels.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Hard interruption ends the damage window; a monster heal cannot be assumed in a champion duel.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Stat(12)[statFormula=2] in Q/R is retained and should not be silently read as total health.
Confidence: speculative. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Riftmaker, Liandry's Torment, Spirit Visage, Abyssal Mask, Zhonya's Hourglass, Mercury's Treads. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

kitEvidence.formula:
Nunu throws three snowballs, dealing [15 / 22.5 / 30 / 37.5 / 45 + (0.12) × AP] magic damage per snowball and Slowing enemies hit by all three by [(-0.3 / -0.35 / -0.4 / -0.45 / -0.5) × -100]% for [1] second. Nunu can Recast this up to twice more.

After [3] seconds, Nunu Roots all nearby enemies that had been Slowed by the snowballs for [characterLevelInterpolation(0.5 → 1.5; raw flags preserved)] seconds and deals an additional [20 / 30 / 40 / 50 / 60 + (0.8) × AP] magic damage.

Nunu and Willump channel a powerful blizzard for up to [3] seconds. Enemies inside are Slowed by [50]%, increasing to [95]% over the duration. Nunu and Willump also gain [65 / 75 / 85 + (0.3 / 0.4 / 0.5) × Stat(12)[statFormula=2] + (1.5) × AP] Shield for the duration before decaying over [3] seconds afterwards.

When the blizzard ends, it detonates, dealing up to [625 / 925 / 1275 + (3) × AP] magic damage based on channel time. Nunu and Willump can Recast to end the blizzard early.

Nunu asks Willump to take a bite of an enemy, dealing [400 / 600 / 800 / 1000 / 1200] true damage and restoring [65 / 95 / 125 / 155 / 185 + (0.1) × Stat(12)[statFormula=2] + (0.9) × AP] Health when used against a minion or jungle monster. Against a champion, it instead deals [60 / 100 / 140 / 180 / 220 + (0.05) × Stat(12)[statFormula=2] + (0.65) × AP] magic damage and restores [(65 / 95 / 125 / 155 / 185 + (0.1) × Stat(12)[statFormula=2] + (0.9) × AP) × (0.6)] Health.

The healing is increased by [50]% when Nunu and Willump are below [50]% Health.
